name: Břevnice (Czechia)
description: Yellow field with a blue wavy stripe from the top to the lower fly and a black arrow laid diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 10 September 2021 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
